# Palm Beach AI Services

> Get found on Google. Get hours back with AI. Palm Beach AI Services works with local businesses (home service contractors, restaurants, and medical offices) in Palm Beach County, Florida. Founder-run by Gene. Office: 172 Roycourt Circle, Royal Palm Beach, FL 33411. Phone (561) 365-8443. Email Gene@palmbeachaiservices.com.

- Get found on Google: websites, Google Business Profile setup and management, Google review requests.
- Get hours back with AI: call answering and missed-call text back, lead follow-up, AI-drafted reports, estimates and invoices, a lead dashboard.
- Pricing is quoted in writing after a free 30-minute call. No long contract. Clients own their website, domain, Google profile, and data.
- Results: Safe Haven Inspections cut inspection report time from 45 to 10 minutes with a custom AI tool. Hero's Pavers shows up in the Google map pack for more than 10 keywords after a website rebuild and Google Business Profile optimization. Next Level Air Conditioning's website and Google profile were rebuilt in September 2026 (results in progress).
- Service area: Palm Beach County (Royal Palm Beach, Wellington, West Palm Beach, Loxahatchee, Greenacres, Lake Worth Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter, Boynton Beach, Delray Beach, Boca Raton), plus Martin and Broward counties.
